root_cause.text: The driver's `ct_vm_map()` function was not updated to use the newly allocated additional PTP pages after `CT_PTP_NUM` was increased from 1 to 4, causing out-of-bounds access when memory allocations exceed the capacity of a single PTP page (512 PTEs / 2MB on x86_64).
root_cause.evidence: The commit message explicitly states: "ct_vm_map() always uses PTEs in vm->ptp[0].area regardless of CT_PTP_NUM. On AMD64 systems, a single PTP covers 512 PTEs (2M). When aggregate memory allocations exceed this limit, ct_vm_map() tries to access beyond the allocated space and causes a page fault." The patch simply reverts `CT_PTP_NUM` back to 1 to avoid the mismatch.
